body:
# Prison Industries HUD
This client-side mod adds various HUD tips that are useful for the Prison Industries Minecraft server.

**Server IP:** play.prison-industries.com
## Features
### Satchel
Displays the satchel and its contents in the HUD.
### Block HUD
Shows the name of what block you are looking at in the mines.
### Notifier
Notifies whenever a block display entity appears.
### Compass
Guides by showing a compass where the nearest block display entity appears.
### Mine Timer
Counts the reset timer of the mines.
## Configuration
You can edit the config file in `.minecraft/config/prison-industries-hud.json`.

You can also install the following optional mods for easy in-game config altering:
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
### Changing Module Position
You may press the Toggle HUD Edit Mode keybind *(default:* `F8`*)*. You can then drag and drop the modules to change their positions.
## Contributing
- [Submit a new issue](https://codeberg.org/rinnarii/prison-industries-hud/issues/new) and elaborate what specific concern that you have. 
- [Make a pull request](https://codeberg.org/rinnarii/prison-industries-hud/pulls) if you want to directly contribute code.
- Join the [Prison Industries Discord server](https://discord.gg/QfXcCT8BYD), so I or other people can assist you.
